top.title: ViCentra Presents Large-Scale Real-World Evidence Demonstrating Kaleido Insulin Patch Pump System Delivers Stable Glucose Control with Very Low Hypoglycemia
top.summary: ViCentra announced real-world data from 3,918 adults showing its Kaleido insulin patch pump system achieved 72.2% median time in range with minimal hypoglycemia (0.21% time below 54 mg/dL) and low glycemic variability (28.7% coefficient of variation) across Germany, the Netherlands, and France. The system, integrated with Diabeloop's DBLG1 algorithm and Dexcom G6, demonstrated strong clinical performance in routine use with high user engagement.
